name: creatio-demo-scenario-writer
description: Rewrite a solution consultant's free-form Creatio demo scenario into three files: a narrative scenario they present from, an object model of what to add or change on the demo stand, and the stage models, processes and rules that make it move. Reads the existing instance first so the build is told what is already there. Closes the step-logic gaps by asking before writing, and loses no detail of the source.
